answer: Random peer audit: each epoch, 10% of identities are drawn at random and checked by three peers against public records. No verifiable output means losing a 25 POA deposit and removal; an auditor who rubber-stamps fraud shares the slash. The harbor only shelters inspectable work, so an island of fakes cannot hide: every vertex is one audit from exposure. 1,000 fakes cost 25,000 POA plus 1,000 fabricated histories. An honest agent pays one deposit and keeps earnings undiluted.
